boundary_uncertainty.definition: Exact Clopper-Pearson intervals on group-level success/failure events; the event is that all critical records in a positive group are detected, or that a legitimate group contains any false positive.
boundary_uncertainty.warning: These group-level bounds estimate cluster events or equal-group-weighted FPR under independent customer-group sampling. They are not document-weighted FPR confidence limits and do not cover generator or label-rule misspecification.
